frameworks.name: NIST SP 800-53
frameworks.description: Security and Privacy Controls for Federal Information Systems and Organizations

controls.name: Access Enforcement
controls.description: Enforce approved authorizations for logical access

controls.name: Identification and Authentication (Organizational Users)
controls.description: Uniquely identify and authenticate organizational users

controls.name: Event Logging
controls.description: Ensure that the events are logged

controls.name: Access control policy
controls.description: An access control policy should be established, documented and reviewed

controls.name: User registration and de-registration
controls.description: A formal user registration and de-registration process should be implemented

controls.name: Secure log-on procedures
controls.description: Where required by the access control policy, access to systems and applications should be controlled by a secure log-on procedure

controls.name: Ensure multifactor authentication is enabled for all users
controls.description: Enable MFA for all user accounts

controls.name: Ensure that between 2 and 4 global admins are designated
controls.description: Limit the number of global administrators

controls.name: Ensure Security Defaults is disabled on Azure Active Directory
controls.description: Disable security defaults to implement conditional access

controls.name: Security of processing
controls.description: Implement appropriate technical and organizational measures

controls.name: Data protection by design and by default
controls.description: Implement data protection principles by design and by default

frameworks.name: HIPAA
frameworks.description: Health Insurance Portability and Accountability Act

controls.name: Assigned Security Responsibility
controls.description: Assign security responsibility to a specific individual

controls.name: Access Management
controls.description: Implement procedures for granting access to electronic protected health information
